title: Unit 3 : Session 2 : SLO 1 — Half Adder and Full Adder
sections: 1. Label the Components (Remembering)
Input 1: A    Input 2: B
Output 1: Sum    Output 2: Carry
Gate 1: XOR gate    Gate 2: AND gate
2. Complete the Truth Table — Full Adder (Understanding)
A=0, B=0, Cin=0 → S=0, Cout=0
A=0, B=0, Cin=1 → S=1, Cout=0
A=0, B=1, Cin=0 → S=1, Cout=0
A=0, B=1, Cin=1 → S=0, Cout=1
A=1, B=0, Cin=0 → S=1, Cout=0
A=1, B=0, Cin=1 → S=0, Cout=1
A=1, B=1, Cin=0 → S=0, Cout=1
A=1, B=1, Cin=1 → S=1, Cout=1
3. Trace the Circuit (Applying): A = 1, B = 0, Cin = 1
Output of first XOR gate: 1   (1 XOR 0 = 1)
Output of first AND gate: 0   (1 AND 0 = 0)
Final S (Sum) output: 0       (1 XOR 1 = 0)
Output of second AND gate: 1  (1 AND 1 = 1)
Final Cout (Carry Out) output: 1  (1 OR 0 = 1)
4. Compare and Contrast (Analyzing)
Number of inputs — Half Adder: 2 | Full Adder: 3
Names of inputs — Half Adder: A, B | Full Adder: A, B, Cin (carry in)
Number of outputs — Half Adder: 2 | Full Adder: 2
Names of outputs — Half Adder: Sum, Carry | Full Adder: Sum, Cout (carry out)
Accepts carry from previous stage — Half Adder: No | Full Adder: Yes
Primary purpose — Half Adder: adds two single bits | Full Adder: adds three single bits including a carry-in
5. Design a Multi-Bit Adder (Creating) — 2-bit ripple-carry adder
Stage 1 (LSB): one HALF ADDER with inputs A0 and B0 → output S0 = A0 XOR B0, carry C1 = A0 AND B0.
Stage 2 (MSB): one FULL ADDER with inputs A1, B1 and Cin = C1 → output S1 and final Cout.
Connections: A0, B0 → HA (S0, C1); C1, A1, B1 → FA (S1, Cout).
Outputs: S0 (bit 0), S1 (bit 1), Cout (final carry).
